$comment: Where the office's real materials come from, and how each one is reduced to a
64px atlas tile. Run `node scripts/bake-textures.mjs` to refresh the baked output.
Every source here must be public domain or permissively licensed, and the licence
must be recorded below — the baked pixels ship in the repository.
To add your own texture: drop a PNG anywhere reachable, add an entry with its URL
(or a `file` path relative to the repo root), and re-run the script. Nothing else

tiles.note: One shared fibre channel; the four carpet colours tint it. Storing luminance rather than four RGB copies keeps the variants consistent and the payload small.
